Connection icons

Rich tool descriptions
Add action names and intent descriptions to all tool calls. Provides richer activity context in sessions.
Background session alerts
Show an in-app alert above the chat when a background session finishes
Project color highlight
How sessions bound to a project are highlighted in the session list
Stripe + tint
Zen Shell

Native window material, glass chrome, and opaque content. Off by default; the current shell stays unchanged until you enable it.

Enable Zen Shell
Apply native glass or opaque window material after the first healthy paint. Accessibility settings always win.
Window material
Glass follows the system when available. Opaque keeps a solid background. System uses the platform default.
System
Workbench (experimental)

Preview of the new shell chrome. Experimental features are on by default.

Activity rail, tabs, inspector
Unified shell layout with tabs around the panel stack
Mode bar
Show Sessions, Meetings, Tasks and other modes in the top bar
Top chrome v2
Mode bar plus a utility rail (search, new session, settings)
Tab groups
Group the tab strip by split columns
Browser as surface
Show OS browser windows in the surface tab strip instead of the top-bar badges
Status bar
Durable Local / Remote / Offline status at the bottom of the window
Session inspector
Files, git, and browser in the session inspector. On by default.
Chat chrome
Prompt history, turn progress, and session cost in the status area. On by default.
Agent context
Context dashboard, MCP lens, and fallback status. Needs the session inspector.
Extension Center
Skills, sources, and automations on one screen. On by default.
Agent Teams
Captain skill using spawn_session and messaging. Cordis dsh-agent-teams stays not installed. On by default.
“More” screens

Extra screens in the left rail. Turning one off hides it; its data is kept.

Dossier
People & company cards, pre-call summary · workbench.mode.dossier.v1
Radar
Topics, competitors and keywords; a daily agent sweep and a morning digest. · workbench.mode.radar.v1
Decisions
A log of decisions from sessions, meetings and messages; agents see it and don’t re-propose rejected options. · workbench.mode.decisions.v1
Agent center
All agents and background runs: running, waiting for you, stuck, cost, stop and pause. · workbench.mode.agents.v1
Focus
The day on one screen: calendar, top three tasks, Inbox and a deep-work timer. · workbench.mode.focus.v1
Mode screens

Screens in the titlebar mode pill (⌥⌘1…7). Turning one off hides it from the pill; your data stays.

Tasks
Show this mode in the titlebar pill and on its ⌥⌘ shortcut
Meetings
Show this mode in the titlebar pill and on its ⌥⌘ shortcut

Not installed

These runtimes stay out of Rox. The list is frozen.

Second chat client
Notifications already live in this app. Not a second client.
Not installed
Extra memory runtime
Memory already lives in Rox. We will not add another memory host.
Not installed
Plugin hot reload
Flags and RPC refresh are the hot path. No plugin HMR runtime.
Not installed
Agent-teams runtime
Cordis plugin stays out. Opt-in Rox skill is Appearance → Agent Teams (workbench.harness.agentTeams).
Not installed
Vision CLI plugin
Vision models and the browser tool already cover this.
Not installed
Search CLI plugin
Use MCP or API sources. Do not embed search keys.
Not installed
Extra automation runtime
Automations are already first-party.
Not installed
Remote-control compatibility
Not a Rox goal. No compatibility-mode host.
Not installed
Conation

Opt-in Conation data-plane panes in Rox. All off by default; no Timeline mode.

Conation shell
Master gate for Conation panes (workbench.conation.shell). Default off.
Conation inspector host
Empty inspector host for later domain WPs (workbench.conation.inspector). Needs shell. Default off.
Conation surfaces skill
Gate for Conation surfaces skill registration (skills.conation.surfaces). Default off; no skill registered yet.
Soup client
Read-only Conation Soup GraphQL client (workbench.conation.soupClient). Default off.
Notes bridge
Read-only Conation Notes bridge (workbench.conation.notesBridge). Default off.
DSS client
Read-only Conation DSS/Drive HTTP client (workbench.conation.dssClient). Default off.
SessionApply (Conation)
SessionApply consumer stub linked to AgentTeamsStore (workbench.conation.sessionApply). Default off. Not Cordis.
Fund canvas link
Open the Fund canvas in Conation via a link. Off by default.
Board link
Open the board in Conation via a link. Off by default.
